cohort: The study included 203 mother-newborn (51.7% girls) pairs from the ENVIRONAGE birth cohort.
finding: Placental miR-34a, miR-146a, miR-210 and miR-222 expression were positively associated with placental relative telomere length in newborn girls, while higher expression of placental miR-21 was weakly associated with shorter placental telomere length in newborn boys.
gest_age: N/A (gestational age was adjusted for as a covariate, but no specific range or average for the cohort is provided)
